title: Rededication: 25 Chislev 148 SE (1 Macc 4:52) = Dec 165 or Dec 164 BC
proposed_synchronization: The Seleucid date 25 Chislev 148 converts to December 165 BC on the Macedonian (autumn 312) epoch used by Driver and Montgomery, or to December 164 BC on a spring-311 epoch; Josephus's 154th Olympiad (Ol. 154.1 = 164/163 on the standard epoch, operator calculation) favours 164.
dating_method: Seleucid-era date; epoch of 1 Maccabees' reckoning disputed
assumptions: The two Seleucid-era epochs in 1 Maccabees are not resolved here; the window deliberately spans both.
Olympiad conversion (Ol. 1 = 776 BC) is an operator calculation, not a source statement.

window.basis: Covers Chislev under both Seleucid-era epochs: from mid-Nov 165 BC to mid-Jan 163 BC. Driver (p. 119) and Montgomery give Dec 165; Josephus's Olympiad points to Dec 164.
